newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal -Basis flat, trade awaits expiry.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal -Basis flat, trade awaits expiry.

text.p: Soybean basis offers were unchanged in lackluster dealings Thursday, brokers said.
The upcoming Christmas holiday and the impending expiration of the CBOT December soymeal contract has dulled enthusiasm for trading, some sources said.
"It's quiet, dead quiet," one Indiana broker said. "A lot of guys are going to take next week off, so its going to be pretty slow on the buy and sell side for the next week or so."
December soymeal expires at 1201 CST Thursday. December still holds a heavy premium to January, and many dealers were expecting a volatile expiration.
The trade is looking for the National Oilseed Processors Association to again report a strong crushing pace because there were few incidences of downtime, dealers said.
Estimates for the crush ranged from 29.8 million to 30.6 million bushels. Those estimates compare with last week's crush of 30.7 million bushels.
